rooms.name: Front Gates
rooms.description: The imposing wrought iron gates of the Redmist Estate. Security is tight here.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go north to enter the entrance hall.

rooms.name: Entrance Hall
rooms.description: A grand and luxurious foyer, decorated with expensive portraits of the Redmist ancestry.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go south to the front gates, west to the kitchen, east to the financial office, or north to the master quarters.

rooms.name: Mansion Kitchen
rooms.description: An incredibly clean and extravagantly stocked stainless steel kitchen.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go east to return to the entrance hall.

rooms.name: Financial Office
rooms.description: A quiet office with plush leather seating and a heavy mahogany desk stacked with financial records.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go west to return to the entrance hall.

rooms.name: Master Quarters
rooms.description: Your luxurious bedroom. A massive bed sits in the center overlooking the estate gardens.
rooms.navigation_description: You can go south to return to the entrance hall.
